card.name: First names before Scottish surnames
card.fires_on: First names or titles (James, William, John, Bishop) in Scottish-themed web text, where a Scottish surname is expected next. Also fires on words like 'named' that introduce a person.

modes.label: First name before surname
modes.description: A given name or initial in a Scottish setting, just before a likely Scottish surname.

modes.description: Words like 'named', a comma after 'Scot', or 'Bishop' that lead into a person's name.
